board-aria: The specimen board. Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter places or selects, Space starts the wave.
build-hint: Build phase: the board waits for you. Space starts.
dossier-boss: Boss specimen on the next wave
early-hint: Calling early pays serum and scores x1.25.
enemy-anxiety-blurb: Fast and frail. Comes in numbers.
enemy-depression-blurb: Slow and plated. Armour blunts every hit; the Cautery and Lobotomizer go through it.
enemy-doubt-blurb: Shielded. A Defibrillator breaks shields three times as fast.
enemy-dread-blurb: Heals the specimens around it. Kill it first.
enemy-fragment-blurb: What is left of Guilt. Small and quick.
enemy-guilt-blurb: Splits into two quick fragments when it dies.
enemy-manic-blurb: Surges and stalls, faster than it looks.
enemy-paranoia-blurb: Cloaked. Only a Defibrillator or an Echo II can see it; a Centrifuge splash still lands.
enemy-patient-blurb: A boss. Sheds Anxiety each time it loses a quarter of itself.
enemy-specimen-blurb: A boss in a glass shell. Below half it breaks free and runs.
enemy-surgeon-blurb: A boss. Every few seconds it severs the instruments around it.
key-arrows-do: Move the board cursor and act on its bench
key-click-do: Place the chosen instrument, or select one (on a phone: tap twice to place)
key-letters-do: Upgrade, sell, change targeting, double speed
key-space-do: Start the wave, or call the next one early
log-blocked: Instruments go on free benches only.
manual-rule-boss: Every fifth wave brings a boss. A boss that reaches the door costs 8 or more integrity.
manual-rule-build: Between waves the board waits. Build, upgrade and sell, then start the wave.
manual-rule-early: Once a wave has finished arriving you may call the next one early: extra serum and x1.25 score for that wave.
manual-rule-score: A cleared wave scores 40 x its number, x1.2 if nothing got through, x the map. Containment at wave 40 adds 250 per point of integrity left.
map-intake-blurb: One corridor that doubles back on itself. Where every intern starts.
map-theatre-blurb: Two doors, two streams, one way out. Score x1.5.
map-vault-blurb: A long spiral into the vault. More time to shoot, more to shoot at.
menu-pitch: A clinical-horror tower defense. Specimens crawl the corridor toward containment; you hold them with eight instruments, wave after wave, until wave 40 or the case is closed.
paused-body: The run is saved after every wave you clear. Quitting keeps the last save.
signin-note: Runs, scores and achievements are kept on your account. The manual is open to everyone.
submit-offline: Could not reach the board. The score was not filed.
submit-record: Report filed. A new personal best.
submit-signed-out: Sign in to file reports to the board.
tower-biobank-blurb: No attack. Pays serum each time a wave is cleared.
tower-cautery-blurb: A short searing beam that ignores armour and leaves a burn. Burning stops regeneration.
tower-centrifuge-blurb: Lobs sample canisters that splash a crowd, cloaked specimens included.
tower-defibrillator-blurb: A shock that jumps between specimens, triple against shields. Reveals the cloaked.
tower-echo-blurb: Boosts the damage and rate of nearby instruments. From tier II it reveals the cloaked.
tower-lobotomizer-blurb: Long-range precision that pierces armour. Tier III finishes off the badly wounded.
tower-suppressor-blurb: A sedative field: slows everything inside and wears it down. Tier III makes them take more damage.
tower-synapse-blurb: Cheap, steady pulses at one target. Tier III fires at two.
tut-integrity-body: Each specimen that reaches the door costs integrity; at zero the case is closed. Every fifth wave is a boss. Hold to wave 40 for containment.
tut-place-body: Place it on the marked bench beside the corridor, or move the cursor with the arrow keys and press Enter. On a phone, tap once to preview and again to place.
tut-select-body: Pick the Synapse from the formulary, or press 1.
tut-start-body: The board waits until you are ready. Start wave 1, or press Space.
tut-upgrade-body: Select your Synapse on the board and upgrade it to tier II, or press U.
tut-watch-body: Every kill pays serum. Clearing the wave pays more. Build while you wait.
tut-welcome-body: This monitor is the specimen slide. Specimens crawl along the red corridor toward the containment door. Instruments on the benches stop them.
tutorial-recall-body2: Advances Level, resets board, unlocks towers.
uncatalogued-body: Not yet observed. Hold more waves.
victory-body: The specimen is contained. Score so far {{score}}, integrity bonus included. Overtime continues to wave {{cap}}, harder every wave.
